inputs.text: This massive anti-Trump protest started as a huge "No Kings" rally with crowds packing the streets to push back against entrenched power, but federal officers immediately responded with tear gas and arrests that turned the scene into chaos. Authorities then ordered everyone to disperse once it grew volatile, and at least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland, Denver and.... This is the predictable response from institutions built to safeguard inequality, where state violence is deployed against anyone challenging the status quo and demanding real protection for vulnerable communities.
